Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable headset mic of ASUS P5440FF with ALC256

The ASUS laptop P5440FF with ALC256 can't detect the headset microphone
until ALC256_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
